Scale: the plate is a square, roughly 22–24 cm across in the photo, so I treated it as a side/dinner plate of about 23 cm.

Egg whites: they cover about 40% of the plate, roughly 150 cm². Height is about 2.5 cm, but the fluffy scramble is airy, so I estimated about 170 g.

Potatoes: they cover about 15% of the plate, roughly 70 cm², in cubes about 2 cm tall. That is roughly 100–110 g, allowing for the roasted cubes being fairly dense.
